subject.title: feat(mcp): add openclaw mcp call for one configured tool

question: Should OpenClaw expose direct execution of one configured MCP tool as a supported core CLI operator command, alongside connection/catalog probing?
rationale: The implementation is bounded and the prior cleanup defect is repaired, but the new command intentionally expands the supported core execution surface beyond existing diagnostics and the separate node-host Gateway command.

options.title: Sponsor the core CLI command
options.body: Accept `openclaw mcp call` as the supported scriptable verification path because it preserves OpenClaw-managed configuration, OAuth, filters, and timeouts.

options.title: Keep direct execution outside this CLI
options.body: Decline the new command and direct operators to existing agent or node-host execution paths if a local core CLI escape hatch is not desired.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the core CLI command
recommendation.body: Accept `openclaw mcp call` as the supported scriptable verification path because it preserves OpenClaw-managed configuration, OAuth, filters, and timeouts.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining question is product-scope acceptance of a new core CLI capability, not a mechanical code repair.
